title: Lovisia to Release Kirby Hand Cream with Detachable Mascot Caps on November 13 - www.haveagood-holiday.com

 Published: November 6, 2026 A new hand cream themed on Kirby (星のカービィ), the popular game series loved across generations, is coming from the gift cosmetics brand Lovisia (Lovisia Cosme Series), which is known for adult-cute cosmetics. The Lovisia Kirby Hand Cream with Mascot Cap goes on sale on Friday, November 13, 2026, rolling out at variety shops nationwide, and becomes available the same day from 10:00 AM at the Lovisia Online Shop.
 The hand cream comes with a "mascot cap" that can be detached and used as a key charm. It is available in three types, each with its own design and scent: two Kirby caps and a Maxim Tomato cap. With its original Lovisia design, it also makes a good gift.
 For details, see the special site: https://lovisia-shop.jp/lp/kirby_06 
 Lovisia Kirby Hand Cream with Mascot Cap
 As the latest item in Lovisia's popular Kirby series, the Lovisia Kirby Hand Cream with Mascot Cap is a new hand cream that comes with a mascot cap. It is the first Lovisia item to feature a mascot cap. The cap can be enjoyed on its own as a key charm, or the hand cream itself can be carried around as a charm.
 The mascot caps come in three patterns:
 Smiling Kirby (Sweet Soap / スイートシャボン scent)
 Sleeping Kirby (Dreamy Flower / ドリーミーフラワー scent)
 Maxim Tomato (Fresh Fruit / フレッシュフルーツ scent)
 The hand cream body and its scent are designed to match each cap design. Kirby, with his pale pink tones and hearts in his eyes, is a Lovisia original design.
 The hand cream also contains three moisturizing ingredients: jojoba oil (jojoba seed oil), shea butter (shea fat), and ceramide (ceramide NG).
 All 3 Designs
 Sweet Soap (スイートシャボン) Scent
 Dreamy Flower (ドリーミーフラワー) Scent
 Fresh Fruit (フレッシュフルーツ) Scent

 Lovisia Sales Record
 Since launching in July 2018, the Lovisia gift cosmetics series has reached cumulative shipments of 6 million units to date. With designs well suited to presents, it has also drawn attention on the web and on social media.
